name: Futatsuo
source:
Keeper of the Twelve Books, who looks like a cat black cat. The protagonist meets him in the old school building. 
Futatsuo is arrogant and irresponsible, troublesome and childish.
Despite being a cat, he has a sweet tooth, a trait which makes him easy to manipulate.

[Translated from Getchu]
